name: Jackpoll Self-Hosted Surveys and Quizzes
free_limit: MIT-licensed self-hosted survey and quiz builder with form authoring, response collection and analysis; Docker Compose and Swarm deployment supported without a published software usage quota or expiry.
watch_out: Requires self-provided compute, storage, PostgreSQL, MinIO, Keycloak, Redis and email configuration; infrastructure and operational costs are not included. The self-host stack pulls published GHCR images; confirm production configuration, TLS and secrets before public deployment. Not a claim about Jackpoll's hosted plan.
